Variants.Content: The Cowat family, with Coldwater City as its seat, is an ancient family in the valley that still carries the blood of its ancestors. They once resisted the Andals together with Royce of Runestone City, and accepted the rule of Arryn after their failure in the Battle of the Seven Stars. That history allows Coldwater City to remember resistance and compromise at the same time: the courage of ancestors deserves to be told, but the survival of the family comes from knowing when to continue fighting and when to recognize the new order. Today, its responsibilities are still to defend the land, fulfill contracts and maintain valley roads.

The nobles of the valley regard Korvat as an old blood family. The failure of the Battle of the Seven Stars did not erase his qualifications, but reminded future generations that the order today known as the ancient tradition was also stitched together by war and surrender.

The farmers around Coldwater City are only interested in the battle for the throne a thousand years ago in the story of the Long Night. They care more about mountain springs, pastures, and whether the lord can keep the road safe from attacks by mountain clans.
